final_response: The computation completed successfully. Both compute_common_tumour_immune_interaction.json and compute_common_tumour_immune_interaction.csv were generated and were readable. A total of 21 regions were analysed, with 2886 Epithelial-Lymphocyte proximity pairs. Sixteen regions contained both populations. Region R11 at grid position (2,1) had the highest interaction strength at 648.73 distinct proximity pairs per 100 retained cells, based on 1278 pairs across 197 retained cells. The JSON and CSV contained the same 21 regions and agreed across all compared numeric fields and population-status values, with zero mismatches. Epithelial is only a model-derived proxy and is not confirmed tumour. Interaction strength is not a percentage and can exceed 100 because one cell may participate in multiple pairs. These are represented-region research statistics, not evidence of biological interaction, a whole-slide conclusion, or a clinical diagnosis.
